caption: The drawing depicts three objects that appear to be earrings, rendered within a rectangular inner frame on a plain, light beige background. The earrings are gold in color, consisting of a small flower-shaped element at the top, followed by a long, tapering cone that ends in a rounded, translucent or pearl-like bead with a slight sheen. The central and rightmost earrings are identical in form and size, with detailed hooks and components clearly visible. The leftmost earring is a smaller version, also featuring the same structure but drawn at a reduced scale and positioned in the upper left portion of the inner rectangle. The arrangement is orderly, with the two larger earrings vertically aligned in the center and to the right, and the smaller one offset to the upper left. The colors used are primarily gold and white with subtle shading to suggest metallic and reflective qualities.
title: Earrings
